description: The bar chart compares the correlation between ChatGPT's QA performance and ground-truth versus generated answers across three domains—Movies, Songs, and Basketball—using two metrics: Pop_GT vs. Pop_Ge and RPop_GT vs. RPop_Ge. The vertical axis represents correlation values ranging from 0 to 0.7, while the horizontal axis lists the three categories. For each category, two pairs of bars are shown: one for Pop_GT (orange, solid fill) and Pop_Ge (light orange, hatched fill), and another for RPop_GT (blue, solid fill) and RPop_Ge (blue, diagonally hatched fill). In the Movies category, Pop_GT has a correlation of approximately 0.23, Pop_Ge is around 0.1, RPop_GT is about 0.35, and RPop_Ge reaches 0.63. In Songs, Pop_GT is approximately 0.3, Pop_Ge is 0.1, RPop_GT is around 0.48, and RPop_Ge peaks at 0.68. In Basketball, Pop_GT is about 0.08, Pop_Ge is 0.09, RPop_GT is approximately 0.12, and RPop_Ge is around 0.22. The legend in the top-right corner identifies the four bar types. The bars are grouped by category, with each group containing two pairs of bars, and the RPop_Ge bars are consistently the tallest within each group, indicating the highest correlation values.
